# Skill: Security Review

## Fokus
- Token storage/transmission.
- Secret leakage.
- Input sanitization.
- Upload/download validation.
- Dependency risk.

## Severity
- Critical
- High
- Medium
- Low

## Output
- Temuan per severity.
- Dampak bisnis.
- Rekomendasi fix prioritas.
